value.rationale: The four-letter threshold is a motivated open structural boundary exhibited by the 2021 circular-Parikh study. A single measurable covariance governs both distinct failure phenomena, proves an all-length rank-one localization, and yields a complete factorized sign/equality classification across six cyclic orders for arbitrary positive four-block lengths. The interlacing equal-run zero-defect criterion generates infinite equality families despite the four-symbol failure of the universal identities.
